title: Service Timeliness Rule: Delay Points on Package Allowance Returns — Design Studio Selections
content:
Where package allowance on a removed Design Studio Selections line is returned late, delay points are added. Delay points are set by the calendar days from the removal to the day the allowance is returned:

| Calendar days from the removal to the return | Delay points |
|---|---|
| More than 30 | 10 |
| More than 7, up to 30 | 5 |
| 7 or fewer | None |

**Records read.** The date on the line's removal entry in the design ledger, and the day of the return.

**Boundary table (hypothetical removal on 2026-03-01)**

| Day of return | Days | Points |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-03-08 | 7 | None |
| 2026-03-09 | 8 | 5 |
| 2026-03-31 | 30 | 5 |
| 2026-04-01 | 31 | 10 |
